# Functional workflows

## WF-system:001 — Boot sequence (system entry point)
1. Take the Web Lock `lowbridge-active-journey`; if a second tab holds it, stop with a message → `src/main.ts:160-168`
2. `SaveStore.open()` (IndexedDB) → `src/main.ts:36`, `src/persistence.ts:267-278`
3. `store.load(records)` tries the current slot, then the backup; if neither reads, show the import / new-journey screen → `src/main.ts:38-71`, `src/persistence.ts:280-297`
4. `decodeSave` builds a `GameEngine`, which runs `recompute`; the bank is clamped → `src/persistence.ts:235-238`
5. `new GameEngine(records, state)` then `advance(awaySeconds)` → `src/main.ts:74-80`
6. `createUI` and the return summary (if away 60 s or more) → `src/main.ts:119-136`
7. Ticker every 1 s: `settle`, `render`, and `persist` on run end or every 5 s → `src/main.ts:140-152` [HIGH]

## WF-system:002 — A player action
`ui.change(action)` → `settle()` → engine call (`start`, `queue`, `stop`, `attune` and so on) → `render()` → `persist()` (`src/ui.ts:184-187`). Irreversible actions first go through `askFirst`, which uses the engine's `warnText` (`src/ui.ts:213-216`). [HIGH]

## WF-system:003 — Time advance
`advance(seconds)` steps the running activity. When the slot is empty, idle seconds bank up to the cap; while accelerating, the bank is spent one-for-one. A completion runs `complete`, then `recompute` and `reconcile` (log discoveries, apply locks), then `fillIdle` / `resumeWaiting` (`src/engine.ts:677-717`, `src/engine.ts:1088-1127`, `src/engine.ts:1237-1272`, `src/engine.ts:764-790`). [HIGH]

## WF-system:004 — Content change
Edit `src/data/*.json`, then `bun run validate` (grammar, cores, pacing, reachability), then `bun test`, then `bun run smoke` for UI-visible changes. Validation measures pacing by playing the real engine (`scripts/validate.ts:228-280`). [HIGH]

## WF-system:005 — Save write
`makeSave` (sparse delta) → `SaveStore.write`: re-decode, move the previous current save to `backup`, then put the new one in `current`, all in one transaction (`src/persistence.ts:80-107`, `src/persistence.ts:299-316`). [HIGH]
